meta.name: multi-reviewer-patterns
meta.description: Coordinate parallel code reviews across multiple quality dimensions with finding deduplication, severity calibration, and consolidated reporting. Use this skill when organizing multi-reviewer code reviews, calibrating finding severity, or consolidating review results.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 协调多路并行代码审查，去重并汇总结果
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常组织多人代码审查并需统一汇总反馈。
copy.tagline_en: Coordinate parallel code reviews, deduplicate findings, and consolidate results
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often organize code review with multiple reviewers and need consolidated feedback.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按安全、性能、架构等多个维度并行做代码审查,把不同审查者在同一位置报出的重复问题合并,统一严重程度分级,最后产出一份带各维度问题数量统计表的汇总报告。
howto.when: 当你组织多维度代码审查、需要统一校准问题严重程度,或要把多份审查结果汇总时触发。

say.text: 帮我按安全、性能和架构三个维度审查这个 PR
say.note: 按维度分派审查并合并重复发现

say.text: 两个审查者报了同一行的问题,合并并取更高的严重级别
say.note: 同位置同问题合并,取高严重度

say.text: 把这几份审查结果汇总成一份带严重程度统计表的报告

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude coordinates parallel code reviews across quality dimensions, merges duplicate findings from multiple reviewers, calibrates severity, and produces a consolidated report with per-dimension counts.
howto.when_en: Use when organizing multi-dimensional code reviews, calibrating finding severity, or consolidating review results.

say_en.text: Review this PR on security, performance, and architecture.
say_en.note: Assigns dimension reviewers and merges duplicates.

say_en.text: Two reviewers flagged the same line; merge them and take the higher severity.
say_en.note: Merges co-located findings, higher severity wins.

say_en.text: Consolidate these review reports into one with a severity summary table.
